_comment: Pulsed-interleaved excitation (PIE) via micro-time windows (PRD-008). No PIE engine feature: species 0 (donor-excited FRET pair) emits in the PROMPT half of the 32 ns laser period (decay t0=0); species 1 (directly-excited acceptor) emits in the DELAYED half (decay t0=16 ns) into the red channel. Gating the micro-time on prompt vs delay separates the two excitation sources (ALEX/PIE stoichiometry). Immobile emitters keep it deterministic; use population for diffusing PIE.
